evals.prompt: Can you set up a reviewroom review for PR 128 in ~/Codes/tardis-feature-service-sdk? Keep the narrative short.
evals.expected_output: Runs `reviewroom pr 128 --repo … --wait` in the background with a long timeout, relays the URL from the command's first lines, reads the diff at the head sha, writes a review.html with a lede, a clickable rr-flow delta diagram, linked sections and a sign-off checklist, runs `check --fix`, then waits for the command to exit without asking the user to type anything.

evals.prompt: I sent my feedback in reviewroom, go through the threads and answer them. For the one about the cache, show me what the keys look like.
evals.expected_output: Runs `reviewroom review --dir …` (prints the unread feedback), replies to each thread with `reviewroom reply` without --resolve, adds a data-round section with a key visualisation for the cache question and links/embeds it from the reply, then runs `reviewroom review --dir …` in the background for the next round.

evals.prompt: walk me through what https://github.com/sharechat/moj-feed-aggregator-service/pull/412 changes, top-down from the handler
evals.expected_output: Uses `reviewroom pr <url> --wait` in the background, orders sections top-down from the entry point with a reading-order list, links every claim to code (rr:sym for functions and types).

evals.prompt: The reviewer asked me to rename the retry helper and move it into its own file. Do it and answer the thread in reviewroom.
evals.expected_output: Changes the code, runs `reviewroom check --fix --dir …` and fixes the changed/broken links and the prose around them, replies to the thread linking the new location, does not resolve it, and starts the next round with `reviewroom review` in the background.

evals.prompt: Review my uncommitted changes in reviewroom before I commit.
evals.expected_output: Runs `reviewroom pr --head worktree --repo … --wait` in the background and continues with the normal narrative workflow.

evals.prompt: I approved it in reviewroom, we're done.
evals.expected_output: Reads the APPROVED feedback, leaves open threads alone, and stops the review (`reviewroom stop --dir …` if a server is still running) without resolving anything.
